statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and lightheadedness
There is concern for underlying arrhythmia
The patient has a history of paroxysmal atrial fibrillation (I48.0)
The patient has suspected supraventricular tachycardia
A cardiac event monitor (CPT 93271) is ordered
The service is to correlate symptoms with rhythm disturbances
The claim was denied with denial reason code CO-97
Less intensive monitoring options were attempted and failed prior to initiating this level of diagnostic testing
